_comment: Single source of truth for CEOwills reels. If PRESET.md and this file disagree, this file wins.

motion._smooth: 1 Oct: the zoom changes at a cut once the shot has run cuts.min_shot_s; a cut that comes sooner is a smooth join ("join": "smooth"): same zoom, the drift carries on. smooth_frames 0: a dissolve left a double image of his face when his pose changed (#16 v7 draft).

audio._limit_note: the last limiters sit limit_margin_db under true_peak: AAC overshoots up to ~1.7 dB on loud, bright speech (#14 v5, 1 Oct: -1.1 dBTP with a 1.3 dB margin)
audio._nasheed_note: loudnorm target is before ducking; measured result ≈ 11 dB under the voice (v5, Adnan: "make the background hearable")
audio._level_note: 27 Sep (Sofian on #6 v1): 'make the mic volume just a little bit quieter' → master -15 LUFS (was -14) and the bed 1 dB closer to the voice, so only the voice drops 1 dB and the nasheed stays where it was.

cuts._30sep_note: Sofian 30 Sep: 'you can hear me say go at the start of videos' and 'the trimming isn't fast like ExamQA videos' → tighter everywhere: air before a line 0.1 → 0.06 s, after 0.12 s (the quietest frame within edge_search_s after that, was 0.25), pauses ≥ 0.2 s (was 0.3) cut down to 0.1 s (was 0.2). Re-tighten an existing job with pauses.py --edit. This replaces the 26 Sep 'keep a ≤0.5 s breath after a key line' rule.
cuts._1oct_pauses: Sofian 1 Oct: 'please improve the pauses' and 'at the end it's not trimmed properly' (0.8–1.5 s of silence after his last word in every video) → pauses ≥ 0.15 s down to 0.08 s, breaths included (deep_quiet_hf_db 8); a take may be split into pieces as short as min_clip_s because the joins are smooth (no zoom change, dissolve); a real shot shorter than min_shot_s next to a silent ≤ merge_gap_s join becomes a smooth join; the video ends tail_hold_s after his last word. check.py fails a pause ≥ 0.35 s, a lead-in > 0.2 s or a tail > 0.6 s.
cuts._min_clip_1oct: Eyad 1 Oct on #2 v7 at 1:25: 'a weird visual stutter… and a gap' — tightening cut a 0.12 s pause after a soft 'If', leaving a 0.44 s shot with its own punch-in. Inside one take a shot is never shorter than 0.8 s now (pauses.py folds it into its neighbour, keeping that small pause); air after a line back to 0.12 s (the 'd' of 'sorted' was clipped).
cuts._pauses: values for pauses.py (tested on 'culture leaving daughters out'): cut silences ≥ min_pause_s down to keep_pause_s; ASR words longer than guard_long_s swallowed a pause, so only guard_edge_s at each end is protected

length._note: Adnan's takes run 20 s–2.5 min; keep the whole message, cut repeats/false starts and pauses (Sofian's cuts: 69–82 s). Was 15–45 before 'culture leaving daughters out' (99 s).

qa._heads_note: 30 Sep: heads.py (YuNet) gives the top of his hair = box top - hair_k x box height and the tip of his beard = box bottom + beard_k x box height (measured 0.17-0.27 and 0.12-0.18 on #2/#6/#12/#16, plus margin). qa.py checks title/cards above the hair, captions below the beard, and the fill above the shot never reaching his hair.
qa._head_note: qa.py head clearance: top of his hair ≈ face box top − hair_above_face × face height (OpenCV Haar 4.10); an overlay may end at most head_tol_px below that. Calibrated 29 Sep on #6 (hmrc) frames: the Haar box starts at his hairline to ~0.2 face-heights under the top of his hair; 0.12 + 12 px passes what Eyad approved (card end 311 vs hair ≈330, title end 356 vs hair ≈375) and flags anything lower

caption._1oct_note: Sofian 1 Oct: 'put the captions a bit higher below his chin so it's easier to see' → baseline 1450 → 1370; each shot's headroom keeps his beard beard_gap above the top caption line, so they sit right under his chin.
caption._30sep_note: Sofian 30 Sep: "for all videos make sure captions are never on his chin, they have to be below". With the frame moved down 190 px his beard reached y ~1190-1370, where the captions sat (baseline 1235). Now the last caption line sits on 1450 and extra lines stack upward; render.py limits each cut's frame shift so his beard stays beard_gap px above the top caption line, and qa.py checks it on real frames (heads.py).
caption._no_script_note: 27 Sep (Eyad, later): all fonts are fine except the overly styled script (Pinyon) → sans for words + white serif with red underline for ALL-CAPS/numbers; never script. Before that: 27 Sep, Sofian on #6: 'can we just stick to this font [the bold sans], add stronger drop shadow — easier for you and looks clearer' → every caption word in Inter Tight 700 (sans px 72, was 62), heavier drop shadow (blur/alpha/dy passes). The CTA keyword still gets its red underline. Remove single_style to bring back the script/serif mix.

hook._required_2oct: Eyad, 2 Oct: "remove all headers title text" — the videos carry no title; a job may still set one (check.py only demands it when required is true).
hook._note: Eyad (26 Sep): title and CTA up so they don't cover his face, space above not too large, not too close to the edge. Eyebrow cap top 120 px from the top (baseline 143), block ends ≈365 — above his hairline (≈410–490 depending on how far he leans). edge_margin = the closest any top overlay may get to the frame edge (checked by qa.py). History: top 300 → 250 → 143.

serif_as._note: 27 Sep, Eyad: no serif in the title, it reads clearer in sans

script_as._note: 27 Sep, Eyad: no script font — *marked* title words are set in a bigger sans instead

uniform._1oct: Sofian 1 Oct: 'the top header text is too high — in Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts some of the words will cover it' → cap top ≈ 231, under the platform bar (safe.y0 210); 54/56 px so three lines end ≈ 416, two ≈ 350. A shot that has the title and no room for his head runs at zoom 1.0 instead of frame.zoom (render.py headroom).
uniform._note: 30 Sep, Sofian: 'the question mark and text are different size' (small tracked-caps question over 56/72 px mixed lines) → every title line the same Inter Tight 700 at one size; *marked* words no longer change size, _MARKED_ keeps the red underline. top = first baseline (cap top ≈ 108, ≥ edge_margin).

bar._note: 27 Sep, Sofian/Adnan on #6 v1: 'make the top text clearer so it's easy to read, maybe white text on a red background' (like the ExamQA title bars). One solid CEOwills-red bar per line, white bold caps, no scrim; top = top edge of the first bar (qa checks it against edge_margin). style "type" = the old scrim + script/serif title.

logo._ref: measured from the other editor's edit: x 306–700, cap top 1528, baseline 1600 on 1080x1920 (they sit 37 px left of centre; we centre it)

gradient._note: 27 Sep, Sofian: 'add a black gradient like we used to do for ExamQA' — black fade across the bottom, behind the logo and the platform UI (transparent at top, alpha at the frame bottom). 30 Sep, Sofian: 'the gradient is so high and different to ExamQA' → starts at 1300 (was 1000, i.e. across his chest and beard), linear, still doubled; it now sits behind the captions and the logo only.

frame._note: 30 Sep, Sofian: 'zoom into Adnan's face a little bit and then move the canvas down, so now he has much more space above his head and you can add the same call to action at the same size'. The shot is zoomed by `zoom` and moved down by up to `shift_y` px.
frame._fill_30sep: Later on 30 Sep, Sofian circled his head in red: 'it gets worse in the videos too'. The fill above the shot used to be the whole frame zoomed 1.35x and blurred, faded in over 170 px: a ghost of his head sat above him and the top of his real hair was blurred whenever it came within ~360 px of the top (most cuts; in #14 he leans to the plant and his head top was replaced by blur). Now render.py headroom(): per cut, his hair is tracked (heads.py); only the `strip` rows above his hair (minus hair_margin) are stretched up to fill the space (at most max_stretch times, light fill_blur, blended back over seam_px), the shift never exceeds what that strip allows or what keeps his beard above the captions, and a cut where his head reaches the top of the shot (strip < min_strip) is shown as filmed (shift 0). qa.py checks it on real frames.
frame._margins: hair_margin / caption.beard_gap 60 px: the per-cut estimate (raw shot) ran 20–50 px short of what qa.py measures on the finished frames (#10, 30 Sep)

offmic._note: 30 Sep (Sofian: 'you can hear me say go at the start of videos'): offmic.py flags a voice that is loud on the camera mic but db quieter on the lav than Adnan's own camera/lav balance (the director). his_db / cam_db = how far under the loudest 3 % counts as Adnan talking / someone talking; min_s = shortest voice flagged.

notify._avatar_2oct: Eyad, 2 Oct: the card's contact photo is Adnan's black-and-white headshot (from SK Media chat), the same in every video — not a frame of the video.
notify._30sep_note: Sofian/Eyad (30 Sep): the card was too small to look real → style 'ios': a real-size iOS banner drawn from the card's text (1000 px wide ≈ an iPhone banner on a 1080 frame): Adnan's contact photo with the Messages badge, 'Adnan · now', frosted glass over the video, ceowills.com in CEOwills red. Room above his head comes from frame.shift_y. Card text: written per moment in the edit ({"text": …, "at_out": …}), different in every video. style 'png' = Adnan's original PNG cards.
notify._comment: Adnan's iMessage CTAs: one every every_s, on screen hold_s, never in reels shorter than min_video_s. y/width (26 Sep, Eyad: off his face, small gap above): card top 110, native PNG width 807 (crisp, 316 px tall) → ends ≈425, at his hairline even when he leans in (was y 200 / width 930 → ended at 557, across his eyes). 27 Sep (Sofian on #6 v1): first card at 25 s (was 20), each held 6 s (was 5).
notify._27sep_note: Eyad on #6 v5: 'the cta covers his head' — his hair top sits at y ≈ 335–350 in that take → card 600 px wide (235 tall) at y 100 ends ≈ 335. Was 807 at y 110.
notify._sfx_30sep: Eyad sent the real iPhone notification sound (Drive 1npRGhDBtXxlnJIHo8jkmCT0UbFMtfyXR, IPHONE NOTIFICATION SOUND EFFECT (PING-DING).mp3) → trimmed to the sound (1.05–3.30 s), mono 48k, peak -1 dB.
notify._sfx_note: 27 Sep, Eyad: 'use the iPhone message notification sound instead of that ding' → a synthesized tri-tone-style chime (3 quick bell notes, not Apple's file); the old one-tone ping is sfx/notify.wav

lumetri._source: Sofian's Premiere Lumetri on 'business owner juggling' (v6): Basic Correction + Vignette

grade_fit._source: fitted to Sofian's exported Premiere frame (raw frame 62 of 'business owner juggling'): 33³ 3D LUT (captures his vibrance — strong colours boosted, skin protected) + measured radial vignette. Held-out colour error 4.6/255 incl. WhatsApp JPEG. 'curves'/'saturation' are the fallback if the LUT file is missing.
grade_fit._lut_30sep: The fitted LUT (sofian-juggling.cube) had garbage in bright skin tones (only one reference frame): blotchy grey/red patches on his face in #14 and a red cheek in #2. The safe LUT = the curves+saturation fallback + the LUT's difference smoothed (σ 1.2 cells) and capped at ±0.045 — same look, no patches.
